name: @molcrafts/molvis-plugins-official
description: Official MolVis plugin collection meta. Version MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH: major=plugin system, minor=plugin count (4), patch=fixes. Children keep independent versions.

scripts.build: F=0; for w in plugins/*; do npm run --prefix "$w" --if-present build || F=1; done; npm run build:self || F=1; exit $F
scripts.typecheck: F=0; for w in plugins/*; do npm run --prefix "$w" --if-present typecheck || F=1; done; npm run typecheck:self || F=1; exit $F
scripts.test: F=0; for w in plugins/*; do npm run --prefix "$w" --if-present test || F=1; npm run --prefix "$w" --if-present test:py || F=1; done; exit $F
scripts.check: npm run check:manifests && npm run check:meta-version && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:py && npm run test && npm run build && npm run verify:bundle
scripts.lint:py: F=0; for w in plugins/*; do npm run --prefix "$w" --if-present lint:py || F=1; done; exit $F
scripts.verify:bundle: F=0; for d in . plugins/*; do [ -f "$d/dist/plugin.js" ] && node --check "$d/dist/plugin.js" || { echo "bad bundle: $d"; F=1; }; done; exit $F
